sq.q: A graphics rendering engine must perform multiple calculations at once. What advantage does parallelism offer in this scenario?
answer: Tasks such as image transformations and shading can be processed concurrently, maximizing hardware utilization and delivering faster rendering speeds.

sq.q: A data processing system handles large datasets and experiences delays. How can parallel computing improve performance?
answer: By distributing tasks across multiple cores or processors, parallel computing enables simultaneous data processing, thereby reducing execution time and increasing efficiency.
